spec.rawSql:
select status_text as "Status",
       coalesce(program, '–') as "Programme",
       coalesce(phase, '–') as "Phase",
       case when status in (5, 6) then remaining_min * 60 end as "Remaining",
       case when status in (5, 6) and remaining_min > 0 then extract(epoch from time + remaining_min * interval '1 minute') * 1000 end as "Ready at"
from data_appliance
where device_type = 1
order by time desc
limit 1;

spec.description: The washing machine's latest state from data_appliance (MieleJob: the Miele event stream plus a snapshot every 5 minutes).
spec.title: Now

spec.rawSql:
select count(*) as "Washes",
       sum(energy_kwh) as "Energy",
       sum(water_l) as "Water",
       sum(cost_eur) as "Cost"
from view_washing_cycle
where $__timeFilter(started);

spec.description: Washes started in the picked range (view_washing_cycle), with energy and water as the machine reported them at the end of each wash (Miele ecoFeedback) and the cost at the contract price of the hour the wash started.
spec.title: In the picked range

spec.rawSql:
select time,
       case when status in (5, 6) then coalesce(phase, status_text) else status_text end as "Washing machine"
from data_appliance
where device_type = 1
  and time between $__timeFrom() - interval '1 day' and $__timeTo()
order by time;

spec.description: Status and programme phase of the washing machine over the picked range.
spec.title: Status

spec.rawSql:
select started as "Started",
       coalesce(program, '–') as "Programme",
       temperature as "Temperature",
       spin_speed as "Spin",
       extract(epoch from duration) as "Duration",
       energy_kwh as "Energy",
       water_l as "Water",
       cost_eur as "Cost",
       case when running then 'running' else 'done' end as "State"
from view_washing_cycle
where $__timeFilter(started)
order by started desc;

spec.description: One row per wash started in the picked range (view_washing_cycle). Energy and water are empty when the machine did not report them; cost needs energy and the hourly contract price.
spec.title: Washes

spec.rawSql:
select to_char(date_trunc('week', started at time zone 'Europe/Vienna'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Week",
       sum(energy_kwh) as "Energy",
       sum(water_l) as "Water",
       count(*) as "Washes"
from view_washing_cycle
where started > now() - interval '26 weeks'
group by 1
order by 1;

spec.description: Energy and water of the washes per week, the last 26 weeks regardless of the picker.
spec.title: Per week

spec.rawSql:
select temperature as "Temperature",
       target_temperature as "Target",
       case when door_open then 1 else 0 end as "Door",
       status_text as "Status"
from data_appliance
where device_type = 19
order by time desc
limit 1;

spec.description: The fridge's latest state from data_appliance. Alerts: FridgeTemperatureOutOfRange (outside 2–7 °C for 15 minutes) and FridgeDoorOpen (open for 2 minutes).
spec.title: Now

spec.rawSql:
with d as (
    select time, door_open,
           lag(door_open) over (order by time) as previous,
           lead(time) over (order by time) as next
    from data_appliance
    where device_type = 19
      and time between $__timeFrom() - interval '1 hour' and $__timeTo()
),
openings as (
    select time, sum(case when door_open and not coalesce(previous, false) then 1 else 0 end) over (order by time) as opening,
           door_open, extract(epoch from coalesce(next, now()) - time) as seconds
    from d
),
open as (
    select opening, min(time) as opened, sum(seconds) as seconds
    from openings
    where door_open
    group by opening
)
select count(*) as "Openings", coalesce(sum(seconds), 0) as "Open in total", coalesce(max(seconds), 0) as "Longest"
from open
where $__timeFilter(opened);

spec.description: Door openings from the Miele event stream (each change from closed to open) and how long the door was open in total and at most.
spec.title: Door in the picked range

spec.rawSql:
select time, temperature as "Temperature", target_temperature as "Target"
from data_appliance
where device_type = 19
  and $__timeFilter(time)
order by time;

spec.description: Temperature and target the fridge reported (steps: a new value arrives with each change and every 5 minutes). The band marks the alert limits 2–7 °C.
spec.title: Temperature

spec.rawSql:
select time, case when door_open then 'Open' else 'Closed' end as "Door"
from data_appliance
where device_type = 19
  and time between $__timeFrom() - interval '1 hour' and $__timeTo()
order by time;

spec.description: Door open or closed over the picked range, from the Miele event stream.
spec.title: Door
